natural_language: Each reader's height/speed setting and incoming cam are concealed inside its housing. Inspect the CAM HOOD on each reader to expose its live window, trace and forecast; an opened hood stays open. Loaded cards wait safely before engagement. Inspection during a run never pauses the feed. Feed each card completely through its drifting read head. Keep actual card height and feed speed inside the green windows. White grips set the commands; gold crosses show actual card response, with inertia. The blue dot shows the incoming cam 0.8 seconds ahead; the dim trace shows 0.6 seconds behind. All feeds start together and continue while a grip is held or released. A full red damage bar, or early certification, permanently ends this episode. The shared drive couples the two feeds where present. Lift each CAM HOOD tab upward, then drag each white grip on its two-axis pad to set height and feed speed. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage.
